scope: L1a engineering gate and L1a-to-L1b handoff

findings.title: L1b loses the accepted recording identifier
findings.evidence: L1a and /api/l1b/input used Final_Group_04, but L1b report rows, workbook and ZIP used source.

findings.title: Shared single-task gate is incomplete
findings.evidence: During an active L1a hold, /api/multilogue-v2/run returned 200 and started. L1b finalize does not acquire the shared gate.

findings.title: Superseded accepted artifacts are overwritten on reconfirmation
findings.evidence: Revision 2 deletes and recreates the revision 1 accepted directory at the same path, so the older sealed handoff cannot be replayed.

findings.title: New hash assets remain untracked
findings.evidence: validation.html references files that exist and pass build integrity, but the new JS/CSS are untracked while old tracked hashes are deleted.

findings.title: Packaged suite reports predate the final rerun
findings.evidence: Package snapshots remain truthful synthetic evidence; this final report is the authoritative second-round result.

findings.title: API regression coverage stops before full reconfirmation and all task-gate branches
findings.evidence: Independent QA, not the committed API suite, exercised reconfirmation and exposed the multilogue/finalize gate gap.

data_boundary: Synthetic WAV and synthetic candidate fixtures only. No external provider call and no real research-audio accuracy claim.
